scope: Static inspection of named source files and saved evidence; no tests, builds, publication, provider requests or deployment.

sourcePolicy.verbatim: Can you cut and publish a 0.0.22 release off of the latest green main?  These build cuts should always come from the latest green main unless explicitly said otherwise
sourcePolicy.decisionScope: Independent mechanical preparation does not grant a cut/source exception.

inspectedReference.name: origin/main
inspectedReference.limitation: Local ref snapshot only; no fetch, live gate read or current green-verdict assertion.

preparedSource.inspectionProcedure: Read candidate HEAD and desktop gitlink; parse Worker TOML; compare each named file to git show HEAD:path in its owning repository and to canonical staging bytes; SHA-256 each named file.
preparedSource.limitation: Named-file comparison only, not a complete source/import census, dependency validation, signing check or release eligibility proof.

maintainedProducer.sourceInput: Exact 40-character superproject sourceSha plus isolated root; run/run-leg require ownerName.
maintainedProducer.storageConfiguration: PAPERCUSP_RELEASE_STORAGE_ENV or operating-account .papercusp/release-storage.env; credentials remain outside the repository.
maintainedProducer.permanentManifestAddress: Preserve the existing release-host.env address baked into shipped clients; move artifact URLs through the manifest.
sectionsRead: The two invariants — read these before you touch anything

p002ProductionPrerequisite.savedProof: Four retained files delivered with matching digest and size through an isolated GCS-backed Worker; anonymous raw-bucket access denied.
p002ProductionPrerequisite.remaining: Qualified production Worker deployment and verification of original retained bytes at that serving artifact; localhost evidence does not satisfy this.
p002ProductionPrerequisite.limitation: Saved receipt inspection only; no current production probe or deployment claim.

producerRequestReconciliation.readSurface: Read-only workspace-scoped harness_shared.task_ledger query through code:run/dev:pg_query
producerRequestReconciliation.interpretation: The ledger has no observed exit code or committed build receipt for these requests. This does not establish either build success or build failure, nor an available signed package pair.
producerRequestReconciliation.readerRouting: tasks:get reads feature/task rows; capability:bash_output refuses these release tasks as task_not_attachable. Neither reader is evidence of missing execution-ledger rows. Use the release journal/store and retained producer-unit evidence.
producerRequestReconciliation.next: Inspect retained producer-unit evidence and reconcile the original request through the maintained journal flow before any further mutation; do not blindly restart a producer.
